_doc: Blind accuracy census (cycle 76): every pooled number independently re-extracted from committed source by an offline checker BLIND to the stored value; deterministic compare; disagreements hand-adjudicated against source. See scripts/error_rate_compare.py + error_rate_pass2.py.
measured_against: docs/error_rate_sample.json (the committed sample of every pooled number at measurement time)
confirmed_our_errors_note: 1 wrong number (semaglutide GI-AE wrong endpoint) surfaced AND fixed this cycle; the 3 remaining disagreements are checker-side (label wording / estimand choice).
not_recheckable_note: sourced from ClinicalTrials.gov results / full text, so not re-extractable from the abstract the checker was given (not evidence of error).

adjudication.note: Numbers identical (0.80 [0.60-1.06]); we label it IRR, the checker wrote "rate ratio" (RR). A rate ratio on TOTAL/recurrent HF hospitalizations IS an incidence-rate ratio; our IRR label is correct.

ROCKET-AF: checker took the on-treatment/per-protocol HR 0.79; its own note flags the ITT HR 0.88, which is what we store — consistent with the other all-ITT NOAC trials. Our ITT choice is the standard MA choice.
ASCEND: numbers identical (0.97 [0.87-1.08]); IRR vs "rate ratio" wording only. Our IRR label is correct.

fixed_this_cycle.note: Wrong endpoint: overall-AE counts (141/161 vs 61/81) were pooled under a gastrointestinal-AE outcome; the abstract has no GI-specific count. FIXED cycle 76 via an absent-override (declared absent). This is the one confirmed defect the census surfaced; it had passed every gate.

omega3-cardiovascular-events SU.FOL.OM3 (PMID 21115589): omega-3 main-effect marginal on major vascular events, HR 1.08 (0.79-1.47), recovered from full text (PMC2993045) after the _pmc_fulltext citing-article fix; verified against the committed source span at build time, not part of the original blind census.

probiotics-aad-prevention Wright 2015 (PMID 24456384): AAD arm counts 5/41 vs 4/46 percentage-derived from the abstract (12.2%/8.7%), RR 1.40; a genuinely eligible declared-absent trial the extractor could not parse (N received X (P%) format).

probiotics-aad-prevention ECLISP (34541475, LcS 59/131 vs 53/126, primary AAD Abx+30d, RR 1.07) and S. boulardii trial (26973849, 21/246 vs 17/231 with >=1 AAD episode, RR 1.16): double-blind placebo-controlled prevention trials recovered from full text; both move the pool toward the null.
sglt2-ckd-progression EMPA-KIDNEY DKA (36331190): 6/3304 vs 1/3305 ketoacidosis, single-trial harm row (siblings DAPA-CKD/CREDENCE source-absent, not in PMC).
tranexamic-acid-pph WOMAN thromboembolic (28456509): 30/10033 vs 34/9985 any thromboembolic event, RR 0.88; large single-trial harm (WOMAN is the topic sole treatment trial).

screening RCT-evidence recovery (cycle 84): esketamine Chen 2023 (37025256, MADRS -10.1 vs -8.1) and statins STAREE (42670961, HR 0.70) recovered via full-abstract-overrules-incomplete-pubtype; both source-verified.

esketamine TRANSFORM-1 (NCT02417064): combined 56+84mg intranasal vs shared placebo, MADRS MD -18.91+/-13.95 (n=209) vs -14.8+/-15.07 (n=108); completes esketamine conclusion change to k=4 -3.34 (-6.07,-0.62).

Arm counts percentage-round-trip verified against the abstract (10%/15%) with per-arm sizes 61/59; source span committed. Build-verified at pooling time, NOT part of the original blind Codex census.

dpp4-mace-t2d::3-point major adverse cardiovascular events::28893244 (omarigliptin, PMID 28893244): source-reported HR 1.00 (0.77-1.29) verified against PubMed (DOI 10.1186/s12933-017-0593-8); double-blind vs placebo, 3-point MACE, T2D+established CVD; recovered + pooled (dpp4 k=2->3, CI 0.57-1.78 -> 0.84-1.21). Build-verified, not part of the original blind census.

glp1-ra-mace-t2d::3-point major adverse cardiovascular events::40162642 (SOUL, PMID 40162642): source-reported HR 0.86 (0.77-0.96) verified against PubMed (DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2501006); oral semaglutide vs placebo, double-blind, 3-point MACE, T2D+ASCVD/CKD; k=7->8, 0.850->0.856. Build-verified via verified_effects (abstract uses primary-outcome anchor the extractor scopes out to avoid ELIXA-style 4-point mispooling).

colchicine-secondary-cv-prevention::Trial-defined major coronary/cardiovascular composite::CLEAR SYNERGY (PMID 39555823): source-reported HR 0.99 (0.85-1.16) extracted from abstract, Codex-fetched + verified; colchicine vs placebo post-MI, 322/3528 vs 327/3534; k=2->3, 0.72->0.81 toward null.

ticagrelor-vs-clopidogrel-acs::MACE::PHILO (PMID 26376600): source-reported HR 1.47 (0.88-2.44), Codex-fetched+verified; ticagrelor vs clopidogrel East-Asian ACS; k=1->2, 0.84 significant -> 1.05 (0.03-33.9) NOT significant (direction reversal, cross-population heterogeneity).

spironolactone-hfref-mortality::All-cause mortality::J-EMPHASIS-HF (PMID 28824029): arm counts 17/111 vs 10/110 (round-trip 15.3%/9.1%), Codex-fetched+verified; eplerenone (MRA-class) vs placebo Japanese HFrEF; k=2->3, 0.72->0.87 toward null.

colchicine-postop-af::Postoperative atrial fibrillation::42132185 (Post-CABG Arrhythmias RCT, PMID 42132185): source-reported RR 0.37 (0.21-0.66) verified against the abstract (POAF 17.3% vs 46.3%, 163 analysed); double-blind placebo-controlled colchicine in on-pump CABG. Recovered by the PREVENTION_TRIAL_TITLE_OMITS_OUTCOME screening fix (title names 'Post-CABG Arrhythmias', not 'atrial fibrillation', so it was wrongly X2-excluded); k=3->4, 0.79->0.67 (still crosses null). Build-verified, not part of the original blind census.

pcsk9-mace::Major adverse cardiovascular events::41211925 (VESALIUS-CV, PMID 41211925): source-reported HR 0.75 (0.65-0.86) verified against the committed PubMed abstract in LANE_PROMPT.md; selected 3-point co-primary per 2026-09-16 protocol amendment. Build-verified, not part of the original blind census.

noac-vs-warfarin-af-stroke::Major bleeding::19717844 and ::21830957: HM lane recovered registered major-bleeding harm rows from source-verified RE-LY and ROCKET-AF held text; build-verified, not part of the original blind census.

sacubitril-valsartan-hfref::Composite cardiovascular death or heart-failure hospitalization::PARALLEL-HF: CT.gov structured target-endpoint HR 1.0881 (0.6501-1.8212), recovered by the target-result/source-hierarchy merge; build-verified, not part of the original blind census.
build_verified_note: Topics added after the original blind census (dpp4, sglt2-pp, doac-vte) are listed in build_verified_added: each pooled number was verified against its committed source at build time (doac-vte-recurrence: all six DOAC-vs-VKA recurrent-VTE counts/effects re-extracted from the trial abstracts via PubMed and matched), not part of the original independent blind Codex census. Metformin-PCOS ovulation added two under-included trials post-census (Moll 16769748 and Ben Ayed 19522426): each arm count recovered from the abstract-reported ovulation rate and denominator and verified by percentage round-trip (published_rate provenance), not part of the original blind Codex census. PCSK9 VESALIUS-CV was added after the original blind census and is recorded in docs/error_rate_sample.json as BUILD_VERIFIED_POST_CENSUS; it does not alter the original independent re-verification numerator.
design_key_removed_note: Rows removed from the live pooled population by TRANCHE-design-key refusal of reconstructed balanced-crystalloids mortality trials. SH2 recovered the SPLIT (PMID 26444692) rows by selecting source-reported target-class effects; those rows are live again and remain in the committed census sample.
